metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Tank Tops | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom tri blend tank tops for your team or event. Soft, breathable fabric perfect for branding. Shop Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Tri blend tank tops combine cotton, polyester, and rayon for a fabric that feels softer than standard cotton tanks while offering better moisture-wicking and durability. This blend resists shrinking and fading, making it ideal for company events, charity runs, or summer giveaways where comfort and a premium feel matter. Screen printing or embroidery adheres cleanly to the smooth surface, ensuring your logo stays sharp through repeated washes.
heroAltText: Custom tri blend tank tops in soft heather colors, stacked and ready for screen printing
